note: USD per million tokens (input, output, cached_input) at the standard peak rate, keyed by model name without the provider/ prefix. Single source of truth: backend/internal/application/model_prices.json and agent-runtime/app/model_prices.json must be byte-identical (tests in both services enforce it). Sources, checked 2026-10: DeepSeek pricing page (peak/cache-miss rate; deepseek-chat/reasoner aliases bill as Flash); Anthropic first-party API rates. ASSUMPTIONS (list prices recalled for 2026-10, NOT verified against a live pricing page; check before relying on them for chargeback): OpenAI gpt-4.1 / gpt-4.1-mini / gpt-4o / gpt-4o-mini / gpt-5 / gpt-5-mini standard (non-cached, non-batch) rates; Moonshot Kimi kimi-k2-0905-preview and kimi-k2-thinking at the cache-miss rate, kimi-k2-turbo-preview at its turbo rate, kimi-latest at an assumed mid rate. cached_input is the price of input tokens served from the provider prompt cache (cache hits): optional, a model without it bills cache hits at the full input price. ASSUMPTIONS for cached_input (recalled, NOT verified against live pricing pages): DeepSeek cache-hit at 10% of the miss rate; Anthropic cache reads at 10% of input; OpenAI gpt-5 family 10%, gpt-4.1 family 25%, gpt-4o family 50%; Kimi k2 family 0.15. Cache WRITES (Anthropic bills 1.25x input on the first request) are not itemized: they are billed as ordinary input. Organizations that bring their own key pay the provider directly; these numbers only drive the in-app budget and cost display. Unknown models use 'default' (conservative) and log a warning.
